Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — great to meet the Alcedo engineering team. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we keep momentum:

What we heard (prioritized):
- Primary integration: deploy Redwood hosted endpoints for search/assistant features in your web & mobile apps.
- Auth: must integrate with your SSO (Okta); tokens for server-side calls; strict tenant isolation.
- Performance targets: p95 token latency <200ms for short prompts, bulk embedding ops for nightly indexing.
- Quality: retrieval + rerank pipeline for product search; willingness to try a lightweight reranker before committing to heavy encoder models.

Open technical items we want to align on before the deep-dive:
1) SDK setup — will you prefer our Node SDK embedded in the backend service, or direct HTTP from your edge functions?
2) Auth model — Okta SAML for user auth + service-to-service tokens for server calls; need to confirm KMS key access for Private if required.
3) Routing/policies — region preference (US-east) and a fallback chain for capacity/cost (we propose primary-realtime -> medium-quantized -> fallback-lowcost).
4) Structured output / tool calling — you mentioned product lookup calls from the model; we should scope how tool calls map to your product API and error handling semantics.
5) Embeddings & reranker — clarify embedding dimensionality, index cadence (nightly vs realtime), and reranker budget per query.

Attached: initial proposal PDF with rough cost bands and the integration timeline.

Suggested next steps:
- Schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive (dev + infra + security) — can we do Thu 9/9 10am PT?
- Laura to propose a model-routing policy draft before the deep-dive.
- Dev to draft auth checklist (KMS, token rotation, IP allowlists).

If that looks good, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read for the session.

Thanks,
Sergio

Hi all — quick technical follow-up ahead of Thursday’s session with draft recommendations so we have something concrete to iterate on. I copied Dev for the infra specifics.

1) Auth & SDK options
- Recommended pattern: server-side Node/Go SDK using workspace-scoped long-lived refresh tokens + short-lived access tokens (rotate every 1 hour).
- SSO flow: Okta SAML for user auth; for Private deployments we support SAML + IdP-initiated provisioning. For server-to-server, we support OAuth client credentials with rotation via KMS.
- KMS: if Customer-managed KMS is required (Private), you’ll need grant access to our service principal (we’ll draft a least-privilege policy).

2) Model routing & policy (draft)
- Primary: rwd-realtime (optimised for latency) — target p95 <200ms for short prompts.
- Secondary: rwd-balanced-quant (int8) — lower cost, slightly slower but similar semantic fidelity (~+10% latency).
- Tertiary fallback: rwd-cost-eco — for large bulk/low-priority batching (embeddings or async rerank jobs).
- Fallback rules: switch on SLO breach or capacity alerts; prefer region-local variants first (us-east -> us-west -> fallback multi-regional).
- Observability hooks: token-level cost, per-route latency histograms, and example prompt choose logs to detect quality regressions.

3) Embeddings & reranker guidance
- Indexing: batch embeddings in 10k chunks for the 10M corpus overnight; incremental stream for new SKUs in 500–1k chunks hourly.
- Dimensionality: we suggest 1536 dim to start (tradeoff between index size & quality).
- Reranker pattern: use a lightweight cross-encoder on top of a sparse/dense retriever; run top-50 retrieval then rerank top-10. This keeps costs predictable.

4) Structured output / tool calling
- Implement a small wrapper service for product lookup that the model can call (we provide the tool-call SDK). Add deterministic error codes for the model to parse and handle fallbacks.

Action items before Thu deep-dive (owners):
- Dev: prepare a quick demo of SDK auth flows + sample key rotation (Dev) — action: dev_patel — ETA: Thu meeting.
- Sergio: send calendar invite + pre-read (Sergio) — done after this thread.
- Laura: publish draft routing policy to runbook link and attach auth checklist (Laura) — attachment: auth-checklist.csv.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.
